court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. Mohamed Riyaz Additional Public Prosecutor
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to direct the respondents to take further action of the petitioner complaint dated 10.12.2018 on the file of the 2nd respondent police.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Rajamanickam, J.:— This petition has been filed to direct the respondents to take further action on the petitioner's complaint dated 10.12.2018 on the file of the 2nd respondent police.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondents Police.

3. This petition is not maintainable, in view of the order passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court in Crl.OP(MD) No. 13681 of 2018 and a batch of cases, dated 20.09.2018, liberty is given to the petitioner to workout his remedy as per the direction given the Hon'ble Division Bench.

4. With the above said direction, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
